enable_tracing_context: enable tracing for a code block by writing output to a pftrace file
trace_named_event: trace a named operation as a slice within an active tracing session
record_counter_value: record a counter value at a given index between 0 and 7
attach_gc_tracing: attach the tracer to Python garbage collection callbacks to log gc events
review_tracing_module: review the tracing utility module and its context managers for performance profiling
